title: What layout options are available?

researcher_note: 列举五种文章布局，未给切换/保存步骤。

title: Can I group articles visually?
prior_classification: worker false-positive challenge: global reCAPTCHA script; root confirmed actual article body
researcher_note: 可按源或日期分组，未示分组控件及生效范围。

title: Can different feeds use different layouts?
researcher_note: 布局可分别作用于源、文件夹、标签；默认继承和重置未知。

title: Why do I see only part of an article?
researcher_note: RSS由发布者提供全文、摘要或标题；缺正文不必然是下载失败。

title: What is the Saved section?
researcher_note: Saved聚合稍后读、归档、批注、网页和标签；阅读意图、保留和分类是不同对象。

title: How do I save an article for later?
researcher_note: 浏览或阅读时点Save保存；没有实际写入或重复保存结果。

title: What is Read later?
researcher_note: Read later位于Saved，承接留待阅读的文章。

title: Can I continue reading where I left off?
researcher_note: Continue reading声明记录阅读进度，未给精确位置和跨端恢复步骤。

title: Can I receive reminders about saved articles?
researcher_note: Preferences中可选邮件提醒；频率、静默和发送结果未说明。

title: What is the Archive?
researcher_note: 归档保留已读后仍想留存的文章，可移回稍后读；不证明系统强制读完。

title: Can I restore archived articles?
researcher_note: 归档可恢复到稍后读或永久移除；未给确认、撤销和保留期限。

title: Can I save web pages outside my feeds?
researcher_note: 外部网页可用Add web page或浏览器扩展保存。

title: How can I save web pages on mobile?
researcher_note: 手机用分享菜单；目标缺席时帮助要求报告机型、系统与源App，未给自动修复。

title: Can I customize the appearance of Inoreader?
researcher_note: 可设主题、字号和可选按钮；未给设置保存或默认值。

title: Where can I manage my account settings?
researcher_note: Tab bar提供Account和Preferences入口；不是完整账户恢复流程。

title: Can I export my subscriptions and content?
researcher_note: 声明有账号和订阅导出选项，未界定完整备份范围或恢复兼容性。

title: Does Inoreader sync across devices?
researcher_note: 声明源、阅读进度和偏好自动跨端同步；冲突、离线顺序和粒度未知。

title: Where can I use Inoreader?
researcher_note: 声明Web/iOS/Android可用；应用商店链接未访问，构建未固定。

title: What are newsletter feeds?
researcher_note: Newsletter feed是接收邮件到账号的专用源。

title: How do I subscribe to a newsletter with Inoreader?
researcher_note: Add feed→Newsletter feed→命名和选地址；到发布者订阅或转发已有邮件。

title: Can I process newsletters with rules and filters?
researcher_note: 邮件源可用规则和过滤；没有实际自动处理或外发。

title: What happens if I unfollow a newsletter feed?
researcher_note: 取消关注后地址及历史邮件删除、停止接收且失去访问；与功能页90天保留口径未统一。

title: Why is my newsletter not arriving?
researcher_note: 未到信先核准确地址、仍在关注及发布者确认订阅；没有重投/恢复保证。

title: What is text-to-speech?
researcher_note: TTS将文章转成音频；未生成或听音。

title: How do I listen to an article with text-to-speech?
researcher_note: 打开文章→Listen with text-to-speech；没有加载、失败和完成实测。

title: Can I listen to articles and podcasts together?
researcher_note: 文章与播客可混合入同一队列；未测顺序和断点。

title: Can I listen in the background?
researcher_note: Web/iOS/Android后台播放为厂商声明；不证明锁屏、强退或来电后恢复。

title: What are annotations?
researcher_note: 批注包括高亮和笔记；没有真实数据写入。

title: How do I create a highlight?
researcher_note: 选择文本→Highlight text；未知选区跨段、取消和保存。

title: How do I add a note to a highlight?
researcher_note: 选择高亮片段→Add note；与旧功能页高亮下Edit的入口措辞分别保留。

title: How do I add a note to an article?
researcher_note: 文章底部Add note写整篇笔记；与段落笔记对象不同。

title: Where can I find my annotations?
researcher_note: Saved→Annotations回访；未测源文消失和离线恢复。

title: Are annotations available on all plans?
researcher_note: 帮助称笔记各套餐可用、高亮属Pro；没有账号核验。

title: What is offline mode?
researcher_note: 移动离线模式访问选定内容；不推及Web或所有音频。

title: What can I make available offline?
researcher_note: 离线对象列源、文件夹、带标签文章、批注、已保存文章。

title: How do I make content available offline?
researcher_note: 区域属性启用离线；iOS右滑区域找Offline settings，Android长按；联网下载并查离线标识。

title: Do offline changes sync automatically later?
researcher_note: 联网后同步离线变更是文档声明；未给冲突合并规则。

title: Why can’t I read an article offline?
researcher_note: 不能离线读时，分别核区域已启用与单篇已下载；联网完成下载再试。

title: The new Inoreader experience is here!
researcher_note: 历史改版：X已读并隐藏、过滤日志路径、冲突/过去30天提示、播放器与看板。

title: Build active reading habits
researcher_note: 保存/阅读进度/归档范围、网页预览和批注控件；部分图片路径及画面为2025-06，确切修订未知。

title: Newsletter feeds
researcher_note: 专用地址、发布者确认及取消关注90天保留口径；与帮助删除说明未统一。

title: A better way to keep up with newsletters
researcher_note: 建立邮件源的字段与阅读布局；没有取消关注保留语义。
